title: Search begins for CALS dean
summary_en: Members of the UW–Madison community can give input to the search committee through an online survey or at public listening sessions on Nov. 18 and 19.

title: Save the dates: UW–Madison Chancellor finalist presentations

title: Robert George, Cornel West: Truth-seeking starts with admitting you might be wrong
